```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)  # add ggplot2 to Suggests in DESCRIPTION
```

The first paragraph states the question this vignette answers. Keep it short;
let code, output, and figures carry the argument.

## A first result

```{r}
summary(mtcars$mpg)
```

**Tip.** Callouts come in `callout-note`, `callout-tip`, `callout-warning` and

## A figure

The format sets `theme_albers()` for the render, so plots match the page.

```{r mpg-weight, fig.cap = "Heavier cars travel fewer miles per gallon."}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  albersdown::scale_color_albers() +
  labs(x = "Weight (1000 lbs)", y = "Miles per gallon", colour = "Cylinders")
```
